title: LA Clippers at Golden State Warriors odds, picks and predictions
text:
Clippers at Warriors odds, picks and predictions NFL MLB NBA NHL NCAA Football NCAA Basketball UFC/MMA PGA Tour Games NBA LA Clippers at Golden State Warriors odds, picks and predictions
 Nathan Beighle Sportsbook Wire Nov. 1, 2026, 11:30 a.m. ET The LA Clippers (1-4) and Golden State Warriors (3-3) meet Sunday in a Western Conference clash. Tip from the Chase Center in San Francisco, California, is set for 8:30 p.m. ET. Let's analyze NBA odds around the Clippers vs. Warriors odds and make our expert NBA picks and predictions for the best bets.
 2025-26 season series: Clippers won 3-1 including a split in San Francisco, and also beat the Warriors in a Play-In game
 The Clippers lost to the Minnesota Timberwolves 127-101 Friday, failing to cover as a 6.5-point road underdog with the Over (222.5) cashing. G Darius Garland scored a team-high 24 points on 10 for 22 shooting. Los Angeles, which started its season out with a win over the Sacramento Kings , has lost 4 straight and is 2-3 against the spread (ATS).
 The Warriors opened with 3 straight defeats, but have ripped off 3 straight wins since. They are coming off a 112-95 home victory over the Los Angeles Lakers, covering as a 2.5-point underdog as the Under (234.5) hit. G Stephen Curry dropped 31 points and drained 8 triples, but he's out for this one. Golden State has covered in 4 straight contests and is 4-2 ATS.

 Clippers at Warriors picks and predictions
 Prediction
 Warriors 116, Clippers 110
 Moneyline 
 PASS .
 No interest; the Warriors (-135) are slightly too expensive to consider here. Look below for the better play.
 Against the spread 
 BET WARRIORS -2.5 (-102) .
 The Warriors have performed well in games that are expected to be close contests. They are 2-0 ATS in games that close with a spread of 4 points or fewer, and even with Curry out, their offense has sustained a high level of play, scoring 122 points on the Phoenix Suns in his lone absence of the season.
 The Clippers have struggled on the offensive end, and that's cause for concern. They've tallied 101 points or fewer in 3 straight games and have failed to cover in 2 straight outings. They are 1-2 ATS in games with a spread of 7 points or fewer.
 Over/Under 
 BET OVER 221.5 (-110) .
 Both sides are slightly trending toward the Over.
 The Warriors are 3-1 O/U in their last 4 games and have scored at least 112 points in each of those contests. Their defense has been absent for most of the season, having allowed 111 points in 5 of 6 outings. The Clippers are 2-1 O/U on the road and have given up 125 points or more in 2 of 3 away games.
 Best prop bet
 Clippers F RUI HACHIMURA OVER 14.5 POINTS (-135).
 Green is out, so scoring should come easier for the Clippers forwards, which would mainly benefit Hachimura. He's scored in double figures in 3 of his 4 performances.
